glyph_origin: Originally written 𠂇 and 䶹 in the oracle bone script: Pictogram (象形) – a left hand. Compare 又 (“right hand”). Late bronze inscription forms show an added 工 (“work; to assist?”) component, making the current form a phono-semantic compound (形聲) and ideogrammic compound (會意): phonetic 𠂇 (“left hand”) + semantic 工 (“work”), representing the original form of 佐 (“to assist”).
